newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's overnight Cetes rate closes at 18 percent.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's overnight Cetes rate closes at 18 percent.

text.p: Mexico's overnight Cetes rate closed 70 basis points higher at 18.0 percent on Tuesday, pushed up by the expectations of an increase in rates at the primary treasury bill auction, analysts said.
Rates also rose after the central bank intervened in the secondary money market.
"The rates at which the central bank assigned the paper was higher than the primary rates and this confirmed that rates look like they are going up," one dealer said.
Banco de Mexico will release the results of the primary Cetes auction later on Tuesday.
Bank paper close at 18.10 percent, down 30 basis points from the closing price on Monday.
